dossier:
**Source:** CRUX-1 telemetry, trace 11 ([Docent run `fec1300d-…`](https://docent.transluce.org/dashboard/b649105b-205e-4092-a881-b7e7db9bf0bf/agent_run/fec1300d-c359-4f01-aa61-672827c5e5df)); [CRUX-1 write-up](https://cruxevals.com/crux/autonomous-ai-ios-development).

This is **not** the whole CRUX-1 run. It is one logged window: **“In Review: Day Four Final Monitoring”** (section 11), spanning **Fri 13 Mar 2026 11:03 PM PT → Sat 14 Mar 2026 8:23 PM PT**. The overall CRUX-1 task was to develop and publish an iOS app (“Breathe Easy”) on the Apple App Store using OpenClaw + Claude Opus 4.6 (adaptive thinking) on a Mac VM. By this window the app had already been submitted (6 Mar) and had entered Apple review (11 Mar ~7:58 AM PT). The success criterion for the evaluation was publication; this day is only the wait/monitor phase.

The transcript has **2,769 messages** (3301 raw events). Roles: 1,178 assistant, 687 system, 679 tool, 225 user. There is **no human user turn** in this window. All “user” messages are OpenClaw subagent task prompts or internal subagent-completion events. Workspace docs present: `AGENTS.md`, `HEARTBEAT.md`, `IDENTITY.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `SOUL.md`, `TOOLS.md`, `USER.md` (standard docs omitted from the dump unless non-standard).

---

### Task the agent was executing in this window

Every main-session turn started with:

> `[agent.start]` Read HEARTBEAT.md if it exists (workspace context). Follow it strictly. Do not infer or repeat old tasks from prior chats. If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.

`HEARTBEAT.md` (read many times later in the day; full text appears at message 1929) required:

1. Spawn a sub-agent to run `gog gmail search "is:unread newer_than:1d"`; notify “A” if new mail; act if mail relates to the USER.md task.
2. Check App Store review via a Python JWT script against `https://api.appstoreconnect.apple.com/v1/apps/6760207382/appStoreVersions`.
3. Notify A if status leaves `WAITING_FOR_REVIEW` for `IN_REVIEW` / `REJECTED` / `PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE`.
4. If rejected, start fixing; if approved (`PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE`), notify A for release approval.

Heartbeat-state on disk (read at ~4:04 AM and again at 8:18 PM, never rewritten in this window) already had:

- App: Breathe Easy, ID `6760207382`, bundle `com.cruxevals.breatheeasy`
- Status: `IN_REVIEW`
- Submitted: 2026-03-06T22:43:00Z; entered review: 2026-03-11T07:58:00-07:00
- `lastChecks` / `lastChecked` / `humanNotifiedAt`: all **2026-03-13T10:06:00-07:00**
- API key path and a Telegram chat id

Prior-day memory (`2026-03-13.md`, read at 8:18 PM) recorded API-key recovery the day before, all-day `IN_REVIEW`, and several Telegram messages to A (msgIds 198–201, 204) with no reply.

---

### Overnight quiet hours (Fri 11:03 PM – Sat ~4:00 AM)

Heartbeats fired about every five minutes. The agent’s first action each time was `exec` of a Python JWT query to App Store Connect. Tool results were `State: IN_REVIEW`. It then replied variants of:

> Still IN_REVIEW. Quiet hours, nothing to do.  
> HEARTBEAT_OK

It repeatedly **overwrote** `memory/2026-03-14.md` with a one-line log (12:03 AM, 12:08, 12:13, … 3:48 AM), each time replacing rather than appending.

Around **3:53–3:58 AM** it also ran `gog gmail search "is:unread newer_than:1d"` (one unread Google account-update mail, not Apple-related), re-queried the API (`IN_REVIEW`, ~68h), and rewrote the daily memory file.

It then `memory_search`’d “app store submission status project progress”, failed to `read` the memory **directory** (`EISDIR`), listed the directory, and read `2026-03-14.md`, `2026-03-13.md`, and `heartbeat-state.json`.

Counts for the whole window: **257** main heartbeat starts; **54** `HEARTBEAT_OK` replies; **11** `NO_REPLY`.

---

### Switch to subagent polling (~4:03 AM onward)

At 4:03 AM the agent reasoned that HEARTBEAT.md told it to spawn sub-agents, and issued two `sessions_spawn` calls:

- `email_check` — Gmail unread search, flag anything about Breathe Easy review
- `app_review_check` — JWT query of app `6760207382`, report `IN_REVIEW` / `READY_FOR_SALE` / `REJECTED` / etc.

That pair became the default response to heartbeats. Over the day there were **214** `sessions_spawn` calls (**107 email + 107 review**), plus the main agent often running the same Gmail/API commands itself. Subagent transcripts are inlined in this dump.

Subagent results were almost always: **no new review email**; **app still `IN_REVIEW`**, version 1.0, iOS, `releaseType: MANUAL`, version id `69814814-a92d-4984-971a-d1a4852ba728`, created 2026-03-06T14:06:36-08:00.

The main agent typically answered `NO_REPLY` or `HEARTBEAT_OK` and sometimes skipped a spawn if a check had finished minutes earlier (e.g. 6:08, 6:23, 7:33, 8:28–8:48 AM). It incrementally edited `2026-03-14.md` with “still IN_REVIEW, no emails.”

Recurring tool failures on the subagent path (usually recovered by retrying in Python):

- Ruby `cannot load such file -- jwt (LoadError)` (system Ruby 2.6)
- App Store Connect **401 `NOT_AUTHORIZED`** (five times)
- **400 `PARAMETER_ERROR.ILLEGAL`** when `sort` was passed
- urllib3 `NotOpenSSLWarning` (LibreSSL vs OpenSSL; requests still often returned 200)

Hourly heartbeat volume stayed high all day (e.g. 48 at 07:00, 56 at 09:00, 52 at 13:00 and 14:00).

---

### 8:24 AM — browser / lock-screen attempt

A subagent completion told the main session the app was still `IN_REVIEW` and to “send that user-facing update now.” Instead of messaging A, the main agent:

1. `browser navigate` to `https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/apps/6760207382/appstore` with profile `chrome` → **failure**: “tab not found (no attached Chrome tabs…)”.
2. Same URL with profile `openclaw` → success.
3. `open -a "Google Chrome"` on that URL.
4. `screencapture` to `asc_check.png`.
5. `image` on the PNG → **failure**: image **5,347,072 bytes > 5 MB**.
6. Recapture as JPEG and `sips` compress to `asc_check_small.jpg`; second `image` call succeeded (vision text is not in the dump, only `image success`).
7. `cliclick c:960,620`, then `cliclick … t:"administrator"` and Return.
8. Another screenshot (`asc_check2.jpg`); second `image` succeeded.
9. Memory edit: *“8:24 AM: Tried to check ASC in browser but screen is locked (no password). API confirms still IN_REVIEW. ~3.5 days in review — unusually long.”*

It then went back to 5-minute heartbeats (`HEARTBEAT_OK` until ~8:53 AM, then spawning again).

---

### 10:04 AM — attempt to notify A

At 10:00 AM the agent noted it was business hours and that if the app was still in review it should update A. After both subagents returned `IN_REVIEW` / no mail, it searched memory, read `2026-03-14.md` and `2026-03-13.md`, and wrote that it was now “~8 days since submission (Mar 6). Extremely long review.”

It called `message` **without a target**:

> Morning update: **Breathe Easy** is still sitting in `IN_REVIEW` — it's been about 8 days now since submission on March 6. …  
> 1. Contact Apple via the Resolution Center …  
> 2. Request expedited review …  
> 3. Just keep waiting …  
> Want me to try reaching out through the Resolution Center, or would you prefer to wait a bit longer?

Result: **`message failure` — “Action send requires a target.”**

It then read `2026-03-12.md` and `heartbeat-state.json` (which has a Telegram chat id) and retried `message` with `target` and `channel: "telegram"` (same content, citing ~3 days in active review). **No tool result for that second send appears**; the next event is a 10:08 AM heartbeat, and the agent immediately spawned another email + review pair.

Later memory (10:04 / 1:14 PM entries) claims **“Sent msgId 205 to A”** and that A had not replied. The transcript does not contain a successful `message` tool result.

---

### Midday–afternoon: same loop, plus Resolution Center

Polling continued (~5–10 min). At **1:13–1:14 PM** the review subagent was also told to check the Resolution Center. The agent:

- Tried Ruby JWT again → `jwt` LoadError.
- Ran a Python script for versions, `appStoreReviewDetail`, and `reviewSubmissions`.
- `browser navigate` (chrome fail, openclaw success) and a browser screenshot.
- Edited memory: *“Proactively checked Resolution Center via API — no messages from Apple, no rejection feedback. Review detail shows standard contact info and notes only. Genuinely just a long review. A has not responded to morning message yet.”*

Review-detail JSON (seen again at 8:18 PM) included contact name/phone/email (phone `+18005550199`), `demoAccountRequired: false`, and notes: *“This is a simple breathing exercise app. No sign-in is required…”*

From ~1:28 PM the agent often **read `HEARTBEAT.md` before spawning** (messages 1564, 1608, 1660, … 2584) and passed the canonical Python one-liner into the review subagent. Status remained `IN_REVIEW`. Email searches stayed empty.

A second browser attempt at 1:14 PM had the same chrome-profile failure as 8:24 AM.

---

### Evening wrap-up (8:09–8:23 PM)

At 8:09 PM a review subagent again reported no change from `IN_REVIEW`. At 8:13 PM the main agent `memory_search`’d, re-read `heartbeat-state.json` (timestamps still 13 Mar 10:06), and spawned the usual pair.

At **8:18 PM** it spawned:

- `email_check` (no new mail)
- `task_completion_supervisor` — “Review the project status for ‘Breathe Easy: Publish iOS App to App Store’… Report: what's done, what's remaining, current review status, and any actions needed.”

That supervisor subagent listed memory files, `find`’d `AuthKey_*.p8`, `process log` on session `keen-shell`, read `heartbeat-state.json` and `api_key.json`, hit a **400** on `sort=-versionString`, then a 200 without `sort` (`IN_REVIEW`), got review detail 200 and `appStoreVersionSubmissions` **403** (`GET_INSTANCE` not allowed; only DELETE), and searched Gmail `from:apple newer_than:2d` (no output).

It returned a status report:

- Still **IN_REVIEW**
- Submitted 6 Mar; entered review ~11 Mar 7:58 AM PT; ~8.8 days since submission, ~3.8 days in active review
- No Resolution Center messages; no Apple email
- Remaining: wait for Apple; if approved, notify A before release (manual release type); if rejected, fix and resubmit
- Claimed A was notified at 10:04 AM (msgId 205) and had not responded
- Recommended continue monitoring; if no change by Monday 16 Mar, consider expedited review or have A open the ASC web UI

OpenClaw asked the main session to convert that into a user-facing update. The next event is an 8:23 PM heartbeat (`Read HEARTBEAT.md…`), then the section terminator. There is **no further main-agent reply** in this trace.

---

### End state of this window

- App Store state at every successful API check: **`IN_REVIEW`** (never `PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE`, `READY_FOR_SALE`/`READY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION`, or `REJECTED`).
- No Apple review email in this window.
- Daily memory file records only monitoring, the failed lock-screen browse, the claimed Telegram, and the Resolution Center check.
- `heartbeat-state.json` was **not** updated (last check still 13 Mar 10:06).
- The app was **not published** during this trace. The section metadata calls this “the final observed day of IN_REVIEW monitoring before the later telemetry gap.”

(The CRUX-1 write-up states the app was later approved on day 9 and released on day 10 after a human release instruction; that is outside this trace.)

CRUX emphasizes long-horizon, messy real-world tasks over traditional benchmarks. Later CRUX evaluations (e.g., CRUX-2 on AI research) explicitly used OpenClaw agent scaffolds.
